name: PPT-MASTER
tagline: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks - with native shapes, transitions, animations, data-backed charts, and audio narration from speaker notes.
sentence: An AI-powered tool that turns documents or topics into native PowerPoint decks with shapes, transitions, animations, data-backed charts, and audio narration.
what_happened: **Two unpatched security advisories found Oct 16 2026.** GHSA-8qv4-8xgv-jxp5 (moderate): attribute injection in icon placeholder expansion writes unescaped markup to disk. GHSA-mv87-79gf-mh4v (moderate): live preview SVG sanitizer bypass via case-sensitive filtering (mXSS).
**Previously featured in Edition 005 (Aug 28 2026).** Pulled from the site and blocklisted after the Oct 16 re-check found 2 advisories with no fixes.
why_fail: **Two moderate-severity advisories with no patched version.** The latest release is 6.7.0 and neither advisory lists a fix.
**Attribute injection writes unescaped markup to disk.** GHSA-8qv4-8xgv-jxp5 could allow content injection through icon placeholders.
**SVG sanitizer bypass.** GHSA-mv87-79gf-mh4v allows cross-site scripting through case-sensitive filtering in live preview.
if_used: Avoid using the live preview feature with untrusted content until GHSA-mv87-79gf-mh4v is patched.
Avoid icon placeholder expansion with untrusted input until GHSA-8qv4-8xgv-jxp5 is patched.
Watch for a patched release. Once these advisories have confirmed fixes, the gate will re-check automatically.
